title: apiInput
responsibility: Reads JSON objects from inline input, files or stdin and parses repeated query fields.

inputs.name: apiInput.input
inputs.description: The value is inline JSON text, '@' followed by a file path whose UTF-8 contents are read, or '-' to read a JSON body from piped stdin (a terminal stdin is rejected). When it is undefined, apiInput returns {} without reading or parsing anything; otherwise the text must parse to a JSON object, so arrays, null and primitives are rejected.

inputs.name: apiQuery.fields
inputs.description: Repeated query fields in name=value form, where each field needs at least one character before its first '=' and is split there; the value may be empty or contain further '=' characters. Defaults to [], which makes apiQuery return an empty array.

outputs.name: apiInput
outputs.description: The resolved parsed JSON object from the input source, or {} when no input was given. It is never null, an array or a primitive, because apiInput rejects those parsed values.

outputs.name: apiQuery
outputs.description: The [name, value] tuples in input order, with names and values kept exactly as written (no trimming or URL decoding) and each field split at its first '=' only, so later '=' characters stay in the value and an empty value is allowed. An empty fields array returns an empty array.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown through fail() by apiInput when '-' is used with a terminal stdin, when the input text is not valid JSON, or when the parsed value is null, an array or a primitive; also thrown through fail() by apiQuery when a field has no '=' or starts with '='. The apiInput failures reject the promise that apiInput returns, because apiInput is async, while apiQuery throws synchronously.

errors.name: API input file or standard input read failure
errors.description: A Node.js error from readFile when the file named after '@' cannot be read, or from iterating process.stdin when '-' is used, which apiInput does not catch, so the promise apiInput returns rejects with that error.
